There are two ways to make this mint infusion. You can either use dried up mint leaves or fresh mint leaves.
==Ingredients==

* Dried or fresh [[Cookbook:Mint|mint]] leaves
* Water

== Equipment ==
*Kettle
*Teapot
==Procedure==
#[[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] the water in a kettle.
#Pour the boiling water into the teapot.
#Put the mint leaves in the teapot. Let [[Cookbook:Steeping|steep]] for several minutes.
#Pour some hot tea in a cup and dilute with additional water. Even if it starts to look transparent, the taste is still there.
